tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search over all articles on www.mikebild.dev (software architecture, TypeScript, Node.js, React, GraphQL, Python, AI engineering). Returns canonical URLs to cite.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read one article as Markdown with its canonical URL, date, tags and audio link.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List articles newest first, optionally filtered by tag or year, plus all tags with their counts.

tools.name: list_decks
tools.description: List the workshop slide decks on slides.mikebild.dev with PDF, narrated video (video_url, when the deck has notes), exercise repository, related articles and slide count.

tools.name: get_deck_outline
tools.description: Outline of one slide deck: every titled slide with its number, section markers and a deep link, plus PDF, exercise repository and related articles.

tools.name: list_workshops
tools.description: List the publicly listed workshops of workshops.mikebild.dev (title, delivery mode, topics).
